say:1:1422647001:1.text: Thank you! All my ducks are safely back!
say:1:1422647001:1.source_cn: 太好了，谢谢你们，我的鸭子宝贝回来了！

say:2:1422647002:1.text: A person must tend to their own ducks. Hand that duty to another, and you invite failure.
say:2:1422647002:1.source_cn: 自己的鸭子还是要自己看好。本该自己完成的责任交给其他人...

say:3:1422647003:1.text: Yes, I understand now. It was my own fault. I need to be more careful...
say:3:1422647003:1.source_cn: 我明白了，归根结底还是我自己不够上心……

say:4:1422647004:1.text: I'm to blame as well. I meant to help, but I ended up making things worse.
say:4:1422647004:1.source_cn: 我、我也！真的太不好意思了，接受了别人的委托结果却……

say:5:1422647005:1.text: Yes, if you wished to read your book, you should've turned him down. But if you choose to help, then you must bear the weight of that choice.
say:5:1422647005:1.source_cn: 是，如果想看书，就不要答应人家；既然答应了，就该负起相...

say:6:1422647006:1.text: To refuse burdens you cannot or will not bear... that too is a form of responsibility.
say:6:1422647006:1.source_cn: 自己不愿或无法承担的责任就干脆拒绝，也是一种负责的表现。

say:7:1422647007:0.text: Yes, in the future, I will be more serious about requests and promises...
say:7:1422647007:0.source_cn: 我知道了，以后无论是许诺还是做事，我都会更认真一些……

say:9:1422647008:0.text: Ducks are really strange creatures. I had thought that they would be fierce but they only... quack.
say:9:1422647008:0.source_cn: 鸭子……真是奇怪的生物，我还以为会很凶猛，结果只会嘎嘎叫。

say:10:1422647009:0.text: You don't know, Indris! Some ducks are mean! If you're not looking, they'll peck at your fur and take a chunk out of your butt!
say:10:1422647009:0.source_cn: 不，有些鸭子也会啄你的屁股，很凶猛的！

say:12:1422647010:0.text: Still, I would have expected the young woman who failed in her duty to face a harsher punishment.
say:12:1422647010:0.source_cn: 不过，我还以为那位失职的女性会受到更严厉的处罚。

say:13:1422647011:0.text: What do you mean by punishment?

say:14:1422647012:0.text: Entrusted with the care of private property, she must be a trusted subordinate. Yet this lapse was clearly the result of her own negligence.
say:14:1422647012:0.source_cn: 能被安排照看私人财产，应该是很受重视的部下或者仆从吧。...

say:15:1422647013:0.text: Although the loss was minor in the end and you stepped in to mediate, I thought she would face harsher consequences for her mistake.
say:15:1422647013:0.source_cn: 尽管最终而言损失并不大，又有你进行调解，但我以为还是会...

choice_prompt:16:1422647013.text: Although the loss was minor in the end and you stepped in to mediate, I thought she would face harsher consequences for her mistake.
choice_prompt:16:1422647013.source_cn: 尽管最终而言损失并不大，又有你进行调解，但我以为还是会有些教训。

say:17:1422647014:0.text: Yes, the ways of the people and their laws here in the Dark Forest are indeed different from those in Sal'thorin.
say:17:1422647014:0.source_cn: 是的，我们薄暮丛林的人与制度应当是与萨洛克兰不太一样。

say:19:1422647017:1.text: Well, those who were quarreling were just friends, with no higher authority between them. In the Dark Forest, private matters fall outside the reach of the law.
say:19:1422647017:1.source_cn: 是的，刚才争执的二位只是普通朋友，并非上下级或主仆关系...

say:20:1422647018:1.text: If a loss has occurred, compensation will follow. But if no loss was incurred, only the mediation of personal ties remains.
say:20:1422647018:1.source_cn: 如果真的存在损失，那就适当赔偿；但我们已经帮忙挽回损失...

say:21:1422647019:1.text: In essence, the decision to reconcile lies solely between them. I was merely offering a fair critique of both parties.
say:21:1422647019:1.source_cn: 本质上，要不要和好是他们之间的事，我只是公平地批评了双方。

choice_prompt:22:1422647019.text: In essence, the decision to reconcile lies solely between them. I was merely offering a fair critique of both parties.
choice_prompt:22:1422647019.source_cn: 本质上，要不要和好是他们之间的事，我只是公平地批评了双方。

say:23:1422647020:1.text: Lorsan would move heaven and earth to see them reconciled. Eironn and Lyca would offer words of wisdom or set the stage for cooperation, but they will not force it.
say:23:1422647020:1.source_cn: 洛桑会想尽办法使他们重修旧好。埃隆或莱卡会给些建议或安...

say:24:1422647021:1.text: Parisa and I approach matters in a similar fashion, though our methods differ. I believe that interpersonal relationships are private and should not be overly interfered with.
say:24:1422647021:1.source_cn: 我和帕瑞莎处理方式相似，只是思路不同。我认为人际关系是...

say:25:1422647022:1.text: In general, private disputes are typically not dealt with in an overly strict manner.
say:25:1422647022:1.source_cn: 总而言之，在私人纠纷这方面，通常都不会处理得太严格。

say:26:1422647023:0.text: What if it becomes a public affair?
say:26:1422647023:0.source_cn: 那么，如果上升到公共事务层面呢？

say:27:1422647024:1.text: Normally, the Three Sages would issue the judgment in matters concerning the Dark Forest. However, with only two remaining, the judgment will be temporarily handled by the representatives of each faction.
say:27:1422647024:1.source_cn: 那就由负责丛林的三贤者评判。只是现在只剩两位，暂由各派...

say:28:1422647025:1.text: Should the matter prove to be of significant importance, Eironn will be notified to partake in the decision. Beyond that, there's not much more to it.
say:28:1422647025:1.source_cn: 若有更重大的事务，就会通知埃隆一起参与决策，大概就是这样。

say:29:1422647026:1.text: Indeed, the people and the laws here are very different from Sal'thorin's.
say:29:1422647026:1.source_cn: 我明白了。的确，这里的人与制度，都与萨洛克兰大有不同。

say:30:1422647027:1.text: The freedom here is refreshing. People trust each other, and there's this relaxed, inviting atmosphere where everyone is just so warm and friendly.
say:30:1422647027:1.source_cn: 更加自由，也更加轻松。彼此信任，因而热情友善。

say:31:1422647028:1.text: I wish Sal'thorin could be so as well...
say:31:1422647028:1.source_cn: 真是好地方啊，如果萨洛克兰也能……

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 不同的文化有不同的处理方式

say:33:1422647015:1.text: The people and the laws of the Dark Forest are not the same as elsewhere.
say:33:1422647015:1.source_cn: 应该是因为产生纠纷的人，以及薄暮丛林的制度有所不同。
